01 / 04

A different view of innovation

My interest in technology has grown through Computer Science study and events in Riyadh.

LEAP made emerging products tangible. Black Hat MEA introduced another view through cybersecurity. Money20/20 drew my attention to identity and authorisation, while the UNESCO forum shifted the conversation towards accountability and governance.

The connection

The connection to my current legal ambition is the set of questions these experiences create.

Read the deeper context+

I want to understand how a business can use a technology and what responsibilities follow from relying on it. These are student learning questions, not legal opinions.

02 / 04

Capability is only the first question

A demonstration can show that a system performs a task.

My Money20/20 reflection asks what is needed before organisations can rely on that capability in use. Identity, security, reliability, and infrastructure were the themes that stood out to me.

The connection

AI agents made the question particularly concrete: if a system takes an action for a person, how is authorisation established and how much control remains with that person?

Read the deeper context+

I want to examine such questions carefully without assuming that a conference discussion settles the answer.

03 / 04

Responsibility and perspective

At the UNESCO forum, I wrote about who is responsible when AI causes harm, how human accountability is maintained, and how different countries approach governance.

Conversations with people from different backgrounds added to that perspective.

The connection

The experience made me interested in implementation as well as principles.

Read the deeper context+

How is a broad goal translated into an actual process? Who needs to understand it? What information would show that the process is working? Those questions connect technology to the wider organisation around it.

04 / 04

Where I want to take this interest

My next step is stronger research and clearer writing.

I want to distinguish product claims from demonstrated use, a policy ambition from its implementation, and my own interpretation from a sourced fact. The writing is a place to practise that distinction.

The connection

Technology gives me another route into the business questions that interest me.

Read the deeper context+

I want to understand how an organisation decides to rely on a new system, what people need from it, and how responsibility is handled. Further reading and experience should help me move from a broad curiosity to a more precise understanding.
